note: A new enemy walks the roads: armored knights patrol the deeper outskirts, sword and shield in hand, tougher than the sellswords they replace on those routes — and when one falls, it drops what a warrior would have carried: a real sword and a suit of heavy plate armor, generated with full stats and equippable from your inventory like any other gear. The same rule now covers the fighters you already meet: bandit, goblin, and orc archers drop a bow and cloth armor when they fall. Wizards would drop a staff and cloth robes, but no wizard enemy roams the wilds yet, so that part waits for the first spellcaster to appear — nothing is faked with knight art. Knights count toward the Creature Codex like any other beast, and a knight too heavy to carry stays on the ground with everything else until you make room. Also fixed while wiring the new drops: saves made with monster loot lying on the ground now load again — the save check was rejecting loot types like bone, so a save taken after a fight could refuse to load at all.
